<div class="wc-intro">
<p>This page lists the changes to the report Analysis: Dog Poop Complaints in Manhattan that a reader would notice, newest first, including corrections when we published something wrong.</p>
<ul><li><strong>History begins:</strong> 2026-04-07, the day the report was first published. Dates are the day each version went up on the site, in New York time. Corrections made before this date may be missing.</li><li><strong>Data refresh:</strong> only when the report is rebuilt. Each rebuild pulls 311 service requests and other City data from NYC Open Data again, so counts can change from one version to the next.</li></ul>
<p>To report a bug in the report, or to ask for a new feature, <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/mbpo-dog-poop/issues">open an issue on GitHub</a>.</p>

<h2 id="2026-05-21-rebuilt-with-311-data-through-may-19-2026-title">Rebuilt with 311 data through May 19, 2026</h2>
<p class="wc-meta"><time datetime="2026-05-21">May 21, 2026</time></p>
<p class="wc-tags"><span class="wc-visually-hidden">Tags: </span><span class="wc-tag">Data</span></p>
<p>The report was rebuilt with newer 311 data, so several counts changed. For example, the count of dog poop service requests in Manhattan since 2020 went from 2,552 (through April 29, 2026) to 2,581 (through May 19, 2026).</p>
<p><strong>More detail:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/mbpo-dog-poop/commit/11f7438">The commit</a></p>

<article class="wc-entry" id="2026-05-01-citywide-numbers-for-the-february-2026-storms" data-tags="Site Data" aria-labelledby="2026-05-01-citywide-numbers-for-the-february-2026-storms-title">
<h2 id="2026-05-01-citywide-numbers-for-the-february-2026-storms-title">Citywide numbers for the February 2026 storms</h2>
<p class="wc-meta"><time datetime="2026-05-01">May 1, 2026</time></p>
<p class="wc-tags"><span class="wc-visually-hidden">Tags: </span><span class="wc-tag">Site</span><span class="wc-visually-hidden">, </span><span class="wc-tag">Data</span></p>
<p>The report now opens with a citywide comparison: New Yorkers filed 380 dog poop complaints in February 2025 and 1,284 in February 2026, after two winter storms. It also shows, month by month since 2020, the share of all Manhattan 311 requests that are about dog poop. Counts were refreshed with data through April 29, 2026.</p>
<p><strong>More detail:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/mbpo-dog-poop/commits/main/?since=2026-05-01&amp;until=2026-05-02">The commits from May 1, 2026</a></p>
<p class="wc-permalink"><a href="#2026-05-01-citywide-numbers-for-the-february-2026-storms">Link to this change<span class="wc-visually-hidden">: Citywide numbers for the February 2026 storms</span></a></p>
</article>

<article class="wc-entry" id="2026-04-22-hot-spots-across-manhattan-and-where-the-bins-are" data-tags="Site Data" aria-labelledby="2026-04-22-hot-spots-across-manhattan-and-where-the-bins-are-title">
<h2 id="2026-04-22-hot-spots-across-manhattan-and-where-the-bins-are-title">Hot spots across Manhattan, and where the bins are</h2>
<p class="wc-meta"><time datetime="2026-04-22">April 22, 2026</time></p>
<p class="wc-tags"><span class="wc-visually-hidden">Tags: </span><span class="wc-tag">Site</span><span class="wc-visually-hidden">, </span><span class="wc-tag">Data</span></p>
<p>The report now finds the blocks with the most dog poop complaints in each of Manhattan&#x27;s 12 community districts since January 1, 2024. Its maps add the 25 dog waste bag dispensers and the DSNY litter baskets in Manhattan, plus privately owned public spaces and dog runs. The chart of complaints by month, left out of the April 15 version, is back.</p>
<p><strong>More detail:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/mbpo-dog-poop/commits/main/?since=2026-04-22&amp;until=2026-04-23">The commits from April 22, 2026</a></p>
<p class="wc-permalink"><a href="#2026-04-22-hot-spots-across-manhattan-and-where-the-bins-are">Link to this change<span class="wc-visually-hidden">: Hot spots across Manhattan, and where the bins are</span></a></p>
</article>
<article class="wc-entry" id="2026-04-15-districts-compared-with-their-overall-311-volume" data-tags="Site Data" aria-labelledby="2026-04-15-districts-compared-with-their-overall-311-volume-title">
<h2 id="2026-04-15-districts-compared-with-their-overall-311-volume-title">Districts compared with their overall 311 volume</h2>
<p class="wc-meta"><time datetime="2026-04-15">April 15, 2026</time></p>
<p class="wc-tags"><span class="wc-visually-hidden">Tags: </span><span class="wc-tag">Site</span><span class="wc-visually-hidden">, </span><span class="wc-tag">Data</span></p>
<p>A second version compares each Manhattan community district&#x27;s dog poop complaints with what its overall number of 311 requests would predict. Manhattan Community District 12 has more than expected, with a cluster on and around Riverside Drive between West 158th and West 160th streets. The earlier charts comparing complaints with LinkNYC kiosks, dog licenses and rodent complaints were taken out.</p>
<p><strong>More detail:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/mbpo-dog-poop/commit/9d61d01">The commit</a></p>
<p class="wc-permalink"><a href="#2026-04-15-districts-compared-with-their-overall-311-volume">Link to this change<span class="wc-visually-hidden">: Districts compared with their overall 311 volume</span></a></p>
</article>

<h2 id="2026-04-07-the-report-is-published-title">The report is published</h2>
<p class="wc-meta"><time datetime="2026-04-07">April 7, 2026</time></p>
<p class="wc-tags"><span class="wc-visually-hidden">Tags: </span><span class="wc-tag">Site</span><span class="wc-visually-hidden">, </span><span class="wc-tag">Data</span></p>
<p>The first version names the six 311 request types about dog poop and counts 2,510 of them in Manhattan between January 3, 2020 and April 5, 2026, with a chart of complaints by month, a table of 2026 complaints by community board, and a map.</p>

<script>
(function () {
  var roots = document.querySelectorAll("[data-whats-changed]");
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(roots, function (root) {
    var box = root.querySelector(".wc-filters");
    var status = root.querySelector(".wc-status");
    var entries = root.querySelectorAll(".wc-entry");
    if (!box || !status || !entries.length) return;
    var tagBoxes = box.querySelectorAll("input[name='wc-tag']");
    var corrBox = box.querySelector("input[name='wc-corrections']");
    var total = entries.length;
    var noun = total === 1 ? "change" : "changes";
    function apply() {
      var on = {};
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(tagBoxes, function (b) { on[b.value] = b.checked; });
      var shown = 0;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(entries, function (el) {
        var tags = (el.getAttribute("data-tags") || "").split(" ");
        var ok = tags.some(function (t) { return on[t]; });
        if (corrBox && corrBox.checked && tags.indexOf("Correction") < 0) ok = false;
        el.hidden = !ok;
        if (ok) shown++;
      });
      status.textContent = shown === total
        ? "Showing all " + total + " " + noun + "."
        : "Showing " + shown + " of " + total + " " + noun + ".";
    }
    function reveal() {
      var id = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1));
      var el = id && document.getElementById(id);
      if (el && root.contains(el) && el.closest(".wc-entry[hidden]")) {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(tagBoxes, function (b) { b.checked = true; });
        if (corrBox) corrBox.checked = false;
        apply();
        el.scrollIntoView();
      }
    }
    box.addEventListener("change", apply);
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", reveal);
    box.hidden = false;
  });
})();
</script>
</div>
